allOf.description: This parameter must contain the merchant key provided by PayU.

command.description: This parameter must contain the command as cancel_refund_transaction..

var1.description: This parameter must contains the Payu ID (mihpayuid) that you receive in the response for a successful payment transation.

var2.description: This parameter must contain the Token ID (unique token from the merchant) for the refund request. Token ID has to be generated at your end for each new refund request..

var3.description: For captured transaction: This parameter must contain the amount which needs to be refunded. Both partial and full refunds are allowed.

var5.description: This parameter must contain the refund webhook URL.

hash.description: This parameter must contain the hash value to be calculated at your end. The logic to calculate hash is : The string used for calculating the hash is in the following format: sha512(key|command|var1|salt) sha512

key.title: key
key.description: This parameter must contain the merchant key provided by PayU.

command.title: command
command.description: This parameter must contain the command as cancel_refund_transaction..
